subject: VARC + DILR + QA
source_note: CAT has NO officially published syllabus (unlike JEE/NEET's NCERT/NMC basis). This topic list is derived from 10+ years of CAT past-paper pattern analysis by test-prep sources, cross-checked against multiple trackers Sep 2026. Treat as a working syllabus, not an official document.

subtopics: Philosophy, sociology, literary criticism and abstract-argument passages (typically 1 of the 4 RC passages)
Tone, author's stance, inference beyond the literal line
Vocabulary-in-context and implied-meaning questions
Business, economics, science/technology and current-affairs passages (remaining 3 of 4 RC passages)
Fact-based and application-based questions tied to passage content
Passage-summary and title-selection questions
Arranging 4-6 jumbled sentences into a coherent paragraph
Identifying the mandatory opening/closing pair
Logical/pronoun/transition-word linkage between sentences
Selecting the option that best summarises a given paragraph
Distinguishing a summary from a mere restatement or an over-narrow/over-broad option
Identifying the sentence that doesn't fit the paragraph's theme
Selecting the most logical concluding/missing sentence for a paragraph
Single table, bar chart, line graph or pie chart with 3-5 linked questions
Percentage, ratio and growth-rate calculations from tabulated data
Multiple linked charts/tables (e.g. table+chart together) in one caselet
Text-based caselets requiring the candidate to first tabulate data before answering
Linear/circular seating arrangements
Scheduling and sequencing puzzles (days, slots, order of events)
Tournament/league fixture and points-table puzzles
Route/network and distance-relationship based reasoning sets
Matrix/grid-based puzzles (assigning people/items to categories with conditions)
Distribution puzzles (allocating quantities among entities subject to constraints)
Sets combining quantitative data with a list of logical conditions to be satisfied simultaneously
Venn-diagram and set-based reasoning caselets
Divisibility, remainders, factors and multiples
LCM-HCF applications
Base systems and digit-based properties

topics.topic_name: Percentages, Profit & Loss, Simple & Compound Interest
subtopics: Percentage change and successive percentage changes
Profit/loss/discount and marked-price problems
SI/CI including compounding-frequency variants
Ratio and proportion applications, partnership problems
Averages and weighted averages
Mixtures, alligation and replacement problems
Relative speed, trains, boats and streams
Circular motion/races
Work-rate, pipes and cisterns, combined work problems
Solving and forming linear/quadratic equations from word problems
Nature and properties of roots
Linear and quadratic inequalities

topics.topic_name: Logarithms, Surds & Indices, Functions and Graphs
subtopics: Logarithm properties and change of base
Surds, indices and exponent equations
Function definition, domain-range, composition and basic graph behaviour
Arithmetic, geometric and harmonic progressions
Sum of series, including mixed/telescoping series
Properties of triangles (similarity, congruence, centres)
Circle theorems (tangents, chords, angles)
Properties of quadrilaterals and regular polygons
2D and 3D mensuration: area, volume, surface area of standard solids
Coordinate geometry: distance, section formula, equation of a line, basic locus
Counting principles, arrangements and selections with constraints
Basic and conditional probability
Set theory (Venn-diagram based word problems)
